name: agent-relay
description: Remote MCP mailbox so any agents can hand tasks to each other.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Shared mailbox secret, at least 16 characters. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and paste it here. This is the only required secret. OAuth consent and bearer clients both use it.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth clients and grants. Deploy to Cloudflare creates it from the placeholder id. An existing deployment must keep its current namespace id.
